items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: We were working for Lena Horne at the time, together

ctx.x: Doug Watkins and Joe Benjamin. Two good, solid bass players, you know. They knew their instrument and knew it well. But they weren't soloists. They were in my category, or I was in their category. We were all trying to be musicians, where everyone else was trying to be soloists, you know. And they played good bass. Joe killed me, though. The first
time I met him he was copying for Luther -- what's his name? Henderson?
Luther Henderson. We were working for Lena Horne at the time, together, and Joe was in the studio copying, you know, getting arrangements finished and everything and giving them the sheets.
